name: x402-gno-mechanism
description: The gno payment mechanism for x402 'exact', registered on a stock x402 client. Versions are exact so a signed payment changes only when a dependency is deliberately bumped.
//overrides: @cosmjs/encoding's fromBech32 defaults its length limit to Infinity, the long-standing way to say 'no limit'. @scure/base 2.3.0 started rejecting that — Number.isSafeInteger(Infinity) is false — from inside its own ^2.0.0 range, and 0.39.0 of the encoder still passes Infinity, so there is no forward version to move to. Every gno payment hits it: signing needs the chain id, which reads /status, which decodes the validator's bech32 address. 2.2.0 is the last release that accepts it.
